Awesome Aussie Sports Bar
Sep 2026 • Couples
Stumbled across this Awesome Aussie Sports bar with the wife while walking around Saigon.
Probably the cleanest bar we have ever been in.
Ice cold Heineken!! and Excellent air-con.
Met the owner Kev and his wife - lovely people along with the bar staff and the 2 toy poodles!!
Could'nt recommend this place any higher to anyone wanting a great bar and chilled relaxed atmospehere with great people while watching any sport.
Will be back 100% next year to go on the tunnels tours with Kev.
Thanks again Kev & Co.
Nick & Janine
